[ota-hal] OTA-1687: the mission layer remembers itself

Punch items 6-8 of the contrary walker's list
(docs/contrary-walker-bog-dragon-2026-09-05.md), the three that need no deed
ledger. Each was measured on the Bog Dragon by OTA-1686 and each flips a pin.

6. ABANDON DROPS THE MISSION'S CONVERSATIONS. The walker abandoned the hunt at
   stage 3 and took it again: the record restarted at stage 0, but the reeve's
   and Old Mira's encounter records kept their `resolved` phase (keyed
   family:id:stage) and the card component hides a resolved card - so the
   re-accepted hunt showed no card at either person and only the typed verb
   paid. abandonContract now forgets that mission's encounter records (hunt,
   mystery, storyline - that mission's only); the next accept starts every
   conversation fresh, and the reeve's card comes back.

7. THE WRONG VERB ON THE RIGHT GROUND SAYS WHAT THE GROUND WANTS. Every
   matcher spoke only when the verb matched and the ground did not ("Not here
   ... points elsewhere"). "negotiate" and "attack" on the Cradle of Dusk - a
   search stage, boots on the cell - drew nothing about the hunt. A stage verb
   (investigate / diplomacy / attack / stealth / cast) that no tracked stage
   pays, typed on a stage's own cell, out of combat, not naming a chip, now
   draws: The Arbiter taps the slate. "Not that. The Bog Dragon of Old Drakova
   wants you to search this ground here." One reader,
   missionTrace.stageUnderfoot, the same cell test as every other door.

8. THE ESCORT CLEAR SAYS THE CLEAR, NOT THE NEXT BEAT. resolveStageEscortClear
   printed nextDef.narration (and its Arbiter line) on the spot and carried
   it on the close card: the walker read "Mira reads the locket without
   crying" on the Mud Flood Nexus, 46 tiles from her holding, and "the Dragon
   uncoils from" the steeple while standing on the Mud Seas - then read both
   again on the ground, where advanceHunt and the card say them properly. When
   the ground moves, the clear now prints "The last of them is down." and the
   ▸ Next direction on the feed and on the card, and the beat's prose prints
   where the beat happens. A next stage on the SAME ground keeps the prose on
   the spot (OTA-1622's same-tile close): no arrival will ever narrate it.

- app/state/slices/questSlice.ts - forgetEncounters on abandon (three
  families); the clear without the next narration.
- app/engine/missionTrace.ts - stageUnderfoot.
- app/state/gameStore.ts - the "Not that" line after the three matchers;
  STAGE_VERB_INTENTS.
- __tests__/ota1687TheMissionLayerRemembersItself.test.ts - 3 tests through
  the store: the abandon forgets only that mission's records and the card
  arms fresh; the line on the cell, nothing off it, nothing on "look"; the
  brood cleared - clear + direction on feed and card, no apex prose - then the
  apex prose on the steeple.
- __tests__/ota1686TheContraryWalker.test.ts - two pins flipped.
- __tests__/ota1578TheStageSaysWhoIsThere.test.ts,
  __tests__/ota1630TheChipIsNotTheMission.test.ts - pins re-anchored.
